name: subagents-wake
title: A thread starts two subagents, rests, and one wake reads both reports
about: The person asks a thread to check two things. The fake CLI starts two subagents through Neko's own MCP server and ends its turn. Two cards appear; the thread rests as Waiting (its row says two subagents work; the conversation ends on "Waiting on Kitten 1 and Kitten 2"); both subagents run; then both reports wake the thread once ("Woken by Kitten 1 · done", "Woken by Kitten 2 · done"), its final words read both reports and the thread is Done. The sidebar lists one row, never a subagent. The record shows one resumed start with one message holding two <neko-wake> reports.

steps.text: Check two things [fake:delegate] mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check links","prompt":"Look at the links [fake:long:4]"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check images","prompt":"Look at the images [fake:long:4]"}

steps.expect: Two cards, Kitten 1 and Kitten 2, appear in the conversation
The thread rests: its sidebar row says two subagents work
The row's description says the thread is waiting once it has ended its turn
The conversation ends on "Waiting on Kitten 1 and Kitten 2"
The sidebar lists one row only, no subagent

steps.name: waiting
steps.expect: Two cards, the thread waiting, its row
Both reports wake the thread: two notes
The thread's final words read both reports
Still one row in the sidebar

steps.name: woken
steps.expect: The notes and the final words

sh.run:
python3 -c 'import json
L=[json.loads(l) for l in open("$work/fake-record.jsonl")]
r=[l for l in L if "argv" in l and "--resume" in l["argv"]]
w=[l for l in L if "stdin" in l and "<neko-wake" in json.dumps(l)]
ok=len(r)==1 and r[0]["argv"][r[0]["argv"].index("--resume")+1].startswith("fake-") and len(w)==1 and json.dumps(w[0]).count("<neko-wake")==2
print("ok" if ok else ("bad %d %d" % (len(r),len(w))))'

steps.expect: One resumed start, with one message holding two <neko-wake> reports
